description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, managing the main user interface and interactions for an interactive chart with zoom and pan functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for Android app, extends Activity to handle creation, menu options, and user interactions with an interactive chart view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and finds the graph view component.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for zoom and pan controls.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selections for zoom and pan actions on the chart.
